dee-dee.position: MIDGROUND centre but dominant, standing square in the teal beam column, arms spread wide, lit up from within the beam, the brightest thing in frame

pose.overall: standing feet planted wide, spine arched slightly back, chest lifted, arms flung open to either side as the beam floods her
pose.left_arm: flung out and back, fingers splayed
pose.right_arm: flung out and back mirroring the left, fingers splayed
pose.hands: exactly two hands, both her own, both open with fingers splayed at the ends of her outflung arms

dee-dee.expression: rapturous — head tipped back, mouth open, eyes wide and blazing; ecstatic transformation, not pain

dex-doomer.position: BACKGROUND left, small by perspective, hunched at the trigger console behind and below her, watching

pose.overall: leaning over the trigger console, weight on his hands
pose.hands: exactly two hands, both his own — one on the console, one on the lever

dex-doomer.expression: manic grin, eyes wide and reflecting the teal light, teeth bared with glee

spatial_rules: exactly two people in the image
exactly four hands total: Dee-Dee's two splayed and Doomer's two at the console
the frame is tilted on a dutch angle so the beam column runs as a strong diagonal
Dee-Dee is NEAR-MID and large, Doomer is FAR and small; they are not on the same plane
the lab coat is whipping upward in the beam's updraft but remains fully covering
this is the trigger beat of her transformation — her build is still tier 3 here, the change has not yet landed
lighting: the teal beam is the dominant light source, blowing out from her centre and throwing hard cyan rim light along her arms and coat, everything outside the beam column falling to deep shadow, Doomer lit only by the spill
